title: system signal
description: Machine load: CPU, memory, disk I/O, network throughput, ping targets and the last speed test. GET /api/signals/system, polled every 2 s. cpu/load/mem/disk/net are measured natively by the host app (SystemProvider.swift, host-dir/system.json) or by the dev server's own loops; ping comes from providers.ping, speed from providers.speedtest (off by default). Any measured field may be null during warm-up or when the host app's file is stale (>10 s). Not sensitive, but ping keys are the user's own target names.

cpu.description: CPU busy share of total machine capacity, percent 0-100.

mem.description: Memory in use (active + wired + compressed, like Activity Monitor 'Memory Used').

mbs.description: Read + write over all block devices, MB/s (MiB/s in the host app).

ping.description: Latency per providers.ping target name (and names from providers.ping.external_file): milliseconds, or null when unreachable. Empty when no targets are set.

additionalProperties.description: Round-trip / TCP-connect time in ms, null = unreachable.

speed.description: Last networkQuality speed test (providers.speedtest), null if none has run.

at.description: When it ran. Unix time in seconds (float).

ts.description: When cpu/load/mem/net were sampled. Unix time in seconds (float). 0 before the first sample.
